323-1722-2034-3583.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
323-1722-2034-3583.description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
When the Tentacle dies, Falkenrath Noble triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Oloro triggers, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card and cause each opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat from step 2

3602-8095--5.notablePrerequisites: At least one of the two persist creatures does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
3602-8095--5.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing a persist creature that does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Bhaal trigger.
Resolve the Bhaal trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the remaining persist creature.
Resolve the sacrificed creature's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Repeat.

4247-6871-6879-6880.description:
Cast Stonework Puma by paying {3}.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Stonework Puma.
When Stonework Puma dies, Haru triggers, returning Stonework Puma from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Stonework Puma enters, Haru triggers, targeting Stonework Puma as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 3.

628-728-7197.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Loch Mare.
When Loch Mare dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

1170-1477-3446-5131--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1477-3446-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing the artifact, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature
Repeat.

2646-5641-6566.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}, which enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token that enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
When the Eldrazi Spawn dies, Yuna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-7314-7913.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Baxter triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

5670-6792-7818--5.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or higher.
5670-6792-7818--5.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from the persist creature as a state-based action.
Repeat.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4089-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4089-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Glasspool Mimic and Naga Fleshcrafter each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4089-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-3043-3499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures with defender.
215-3043-3499.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Axebane Guardian from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Axebane Guardian by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

698-2661-3692.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Activate Gwenna by tapping it, adding {U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells or activate abilities of creatures.
Cast Aethersnipe for its evoke cost by paying {U}{U}.
Gwenna triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and untapping it.
When Aethersnipe enters the battlefield, its first ability and evoke ability trigger.
Resolve the first Aethersnipe trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the second Aethersnipe trigger, failing to sacrifice it as it is no longer on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

539-1621-7038.description:
Cast Wispweaver Angel by paying its mana cost.
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Toph.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Wispweaver Angel as it's a land due to Ashaya.
Since zero mana was spent to cast Toph, Wispweaver Angel becomes a 0/0 creature and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Toph triggers, returning Wispweaver Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

967-3809-4365-6798-7087.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2044-5231-6972.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Peema Outrider.
When Peema Outrider dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Peema Outrider enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

141-554-2511.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-554-2511.description:
Cast Extract from Darkness by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Extract from Darkness.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Extract from Darkness
Resolve the Extract from Darkness copy, causing each player to mill two cards and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2478-2866-4986-5147.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

586-2438-5258-5618-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one artifact.
586-2438-5258-5618-6747.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

64-864-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
64-864-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Warden of the Eye.
When Eternal Witness and Warden of the Eye enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
64-864-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

2800-4826-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
2800-4826-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites: Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
2800-4826-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Archelos.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Mirari's Wake triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

575-4050-4932.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Whipcorder, adding {W}.
When Whipcorder dies, Yedora triggers, returning Whipcorder from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
Activate Whipcorder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Whipcorder's morph ability by paying {W}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

4316-4659-5004-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Cathodion on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Cathodion from the top of your library by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2757-4499-4878.notablePrerequisites: Market Festival attached to a basic land you control.
2757-4499-4878.description:
Activate the basic land with Market Festival attached by tapping it, adding {1}.
Market Festival triggers, adding {2}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking another nontoken creature you control.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature, untapping the basic land with Market Festival attached.
Repeat.

4763-4766-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When Thermopod dies, Koll and Deathrender trigger.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Thermopod from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Thermopod from your hand onto the battlefield and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

265-2558-3698.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Sly Requisitioner triggers, creating a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Servo token.
Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1, causing target player to mill three cards.
Repeat.

413-2792-5140.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{B}.
413-2792-5140.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{B}.
Activate Kenrith's fifth ability by paying {4}{B}, returning Great Whale from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Great Whale, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1912-2457-4289-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
1912-2457-4289-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Insect token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

914-4702-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Sword of the Paruns attached to Dockside Extortionist.
Dockside Extortionist does not have summoning sickness.
Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-4702-5200.description:
Activate Dockside Extortionist by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
The token Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping the nontoken Dockside Extortionist.
Repeat.

1733-2724-4006.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Nephalia Smuggler. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
